description: Removes one webhook (webhook_id from read webhooks) and its delivery log, as Delete on its row does; nothing more is posted to that address. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: webhook_delete
title: Delete a webhook
